title: Average small countdown timer…
text:
Average small countdown timer…. [[VIDEOID:4972c12a20a3bb9c7186ae784459bcd3]] Pros:
Nice and bright
Includes mounting hardware
Full scale remote

Cons:
White lettering isn’t lit
Feels light and cheap
No battery backup

Average countdown timer. Not very big. See dimensions.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
